implements: PREREGISTRATION safety and UNKNOWN-not-correction rules; conservative diagnostic labels, not a learned online policy
pairing: full native fingerprint, GT-free alternatives; align all detector rows by frame/view/row; physical offline GT must agree
real_correction: known wrong→known correct N01 or boundary anchored false-split birth→known correct existing owner; UNKNOWN transitions never counted as corrections
harm_checks: new mix/anchored false split/pure support split introduced at any row
increase in total wrong-owner observed frames
increase of longest observed wrong episode for any GT/camera
increase in evaluated strict future CLEAR IDSW
safe_correction: at least one real correction; none of the harm checks at any H; strict CLEAR must be evaluable at all H; all altered rows assessed, UNKNOWN disclosed
diagnostic_owner_only: same checks except unevaluable CLEAR; never training safety label
independent_groups: use frozen prospective cross-time components; mixed TRAIN/RESERVED cannot supply RESERVED; no resampling
unexecuted_actions: value null; action-set coverage separate from policy performance
